# SafeUnfollow

> Analyze your official Instagram Data ZIP to see mutual follows, one-way follows, and follower changes between snapshots. No Instagram login, OAuth, API access, or account connection — all parsing happens locally in the browser.

## What it does
- Parses the official Instagram "Download your information" export (JSON format, Followers and following)
- Shows accounts that follow you and you don't follow back, accounts you follow that don't follow back, and mutual follows
- Saves dated snapshots in the browser and compares two snapshots to show newly gained and lost followers over time
- Gives deterministic cleanup review categories, with no AI-generated scoring, recommendations, or automated Instagram actions

## What it does not do
- Does not require an Instagram login, OAuth authorization, or API connection
- Does not perform any Instagram action (no auto-follow, auto-unfollow, DMs, or scheduling)
- Does not upload the contents of the Instagram export to SafeUnfollow's servers; parsing and storage are local to the browser

## Pricing
Free: totals and the first 20 accounts per relationship list, one saved snapshot.
SafeUnfollow Lifetime Access: a one-time purchase (US$3.99, adjusted for purchasing power parity where applicable) for full lists, search, CSV export, and unlimited snapshots. It is not a subscription.

## Languages
English (default, unprefixed URLs), Portuguese (/pt), Russian (/ru), Spanish (/es).
